Subject: Your divorce by mutual consent matter - Petition No. 2579/2025

Dear Ms. Malhotra,

Thank you for meeting us on 25/10/2025 about your dispute with Pooja Rajan. As we understand it, the couple has a young child. The matter is listed before the Family Court at Kochi.

Our advice is to agree a joint parenting plan before the second motion. Please collect the school records of the child and the draft parenting plan and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan
